chunks.l2:
[tal-a27-v01] Now the liṅga-worship hinted in the Mālinī doctrine is told.

[tal-a27-v10] By putrakas guru is to be requested; sādhaka but himself knowing: if he should install not, if then also to be requested, guru should become.

[tal-a27-v02] Of their higher-śāstra-told mantras: not installed; should put outside, then: these, by secrecy, are givers of siddhi.

[tal-a27-v03] Possessing the entry into the greatness of own vigor-bliss: who give siddhi — of them, externality is form-loss.

[tal-a27-v04] And what was said: Samāveśa-full, enjoyer-natured Śiva; in interruption of enjoyment-lust-enjoyment, of nature of restraint.

[tal-a27-v05] Produced from peace-surpassing-rite-hunger-increased body, itself installed, by which he in enjoyment perishes.

[tal-a27-v06] Was said in Jñānottara, and that this by Supreme Lord: Śiva sacrifice-loving, from which especially in mothers' midst.

[tal-a27-v07] Therefore in secret śāstras: which mantras — these the wise — outside not should install ever, especially manifest-formed.

[tal-a27-v08] Hence indeed for the dead's sake installation elsewhere was enjoined; that here in śāstras not to be done, to be done common again.

[tal-a27-v09] Up to tanmayatva-accomplishment, from desired-fruit-arising: putraka, sādhaka, manifest-unmanifest, or should resort to.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-:C27 atha śrītantrāloke saptaviṃśatitamamāhnikam athocyate liṅgapūjā sūcitā mālinīmate eteṣāmūrdhvaśāstroktamantrāṇāṃ na pratiṣṭhitam / bahiṣkuryāttato hyete rahasyatvena siddhidāḥ svavīryānandamāhātmyapraveśavaśaśālinīm / ye siddhiṃ dadate teṣāṃ bāhyatvaṃ rūpavicyutiḥ kiṃca coktaṃ samāveśapūrṇo bhoktrātmakaḥ śivaḥ / bhogalāmpaṭyabhāgbhogavicchede nigrahātmakaḥ śāntatvanyakkriyodbhūtajighatsāvṛṃhitaṃ vapuḥ / svayaṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ yena so@syābhoge vinaśyati uktaṃ jñānottarāyāṃ ca tadetatparameśinā / śivo yāgapriyo yasmādviśeṣānmātṛmadhyagaḥ tasmādrahasyaśāstreṣu ye mantrāstānbudho bahiḥ / na pratiṣṭhāpayejjātu viśeṣādvyaktarūpiṇaḥ ata eva mṛtasyārthe pratiṣṭhānyatra yoditā / sātra śāstreṣu no kāryā kāryā sādhāraṇī punaḥ ā tanmayatvasaṃsiddherā cābhīṣṭaphalodayāt / putrakaḥ sādhako vyaktamavyaktaṃ vā samāśrayet putrakairgururabhyarthyaḥ sādhakastu svayaṃ vidan / yadi tatsthāpayenno cettenāpyarthyo gururbhavet

chunks.l2:
[tal-a27-v11] Guru and here in so-called nirodha: time thus in the Lord he should say; living in this until fruit-end, you should stand until life-end — or.

[tal-a27-v12] Liṅga, and Bāṇa-liṅga, or gem-born, or-then pearl, flower-food-and, cloth, scent-substance-made, and or.

[tal-a27-v13] But not stone-born liṅga, sculptor-risen should consider; metal-risen and gold-risen-except other reject.

[tal-a27-v14] Not and here liṅga-measure-and-the-rest anywhere is used; by noble vigor-mantras what is shone, fruit-giving, for that.

[tal-a27-v15] Of it also by altar-and-the-rest-enjoined-rite he should purify; mantra-offering likewise should be nirodha as said by reason.

[tal-a27-v16] In fire and tarpaṇa, by abundance especially dakṣiṇā of guru, poor-and-the-rest-satisfaction-abundance-sacrifice: thus superior rite.

[tal-a27-v17] In all unmanifest liṅgas primary should be unconstructed; so and there there-said in mark in Pārameśvara.

[tal-a27-v18] In thread, vessel, banner, cloth, svayambhū-Bāṇa-worshipped, river-spring-risen: and no calling, nor even construction.

[tal-a27-v19] Seat-temple-mantra-portion-time-rule, and not manifest or in painting-book-and-the-rest, god-wood-gold-born.

[tal-a27-v20] Now by initiated good-artisan-made installs guru, or-else mark-endowed-head-shell-supported.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-guruścātra nirodhākhye kāla itthaṃ vibhau vadet / jīvatyasminphalāntaṃ tvaṃ tiṣṭherjīvāvadhīti vā liṅgaṃ ca bāṇaliṅgaṃ vā ratnajaṃ vātha mauktikam / pauṣpamānnamatho vāstraṃ gandhadravyakṛtaṃ ca vā natu pāṣāṇajaṃ liṅgaṃ śilpyutthaṃ parikalpayet / dhātūtthaṃ ca suvarṇotthavarjamanyadvivarjayet na cātra liṅgamānādi kvacidapyupayujyate / udāravīryairmantrairyadbhāsitaṃ phaladaṃ hi tat tasyāpi sthaṇḍilādyuktavidhinā śuddhimācaret / mantrārpaṇaṃ tathaiva syānnirodhastūktayuktitaḥ agnau ca tarpaṇaṃ bhūriviśeṣāddakṣiṇā guroḥ / dīnāditṛptirvibhavādyāga ityadhiko vidhiḥ sarveṣvavyaktaliṅgeṣu pradhānaṃ syādakalpitam / tathā ca tatra tatroktaṃ lakṣaṇe pārameśvare sūtre pātre dhvaje vastre svayambhūbāṇapūjite / nadīprasravaṇotthe ca nāhvānaṃ nāpi kalpanā pīṭhaprasādamantrāṃśavelādiniyamo naca / vyaktaṃ vā citrapustādau devadārusuvarṇajam atha dīkṣitasacchilpikṛtaṃ sthāpayate guruḥ / athavā lakṣaṇopetamūrdhatatkarparāśritam

chunks.l2:
[tal-a27-v21] By row-chakra-triśūla-lotus-rite should resort to tūra; its mark I speak, in venerable Picu-śāstra was set forth.

[tal-a27-v22] In tūra yoga always is praised, giver of siddhi in faultless; by nets-torn, by holes-teeth-deficient-excess disease.

[tal-a27-v23] In suitable and in tūra loss would be, in its deficient sacrifice supreme; desired indeed would-be-tūra — thus some adopted.

[tal-a27-v24] Gurus but in rite, in desired, from effort reject faults — thus they explain Picu-spoken; not in obligatory rite — thus this.

[tal-a27-v25] In venerable Siddhātantra was said and tūra-mark-supreme: in one-to-four-fragment, in cow-mouth, in full-moon.

[tal-a27-v26] In lotus-go-rocanā-pearl-salt-crystal-like, in one-to-five-hundred-holes-vidyā-line-possessing, in auspicious.

[tal-a27-v27] Not in rough-crooked-fragment-long-depressed-with-bindu: by smooth, by diamond-needle here, clearly, goddess-group-possessing.

[tal-a27-v28] All should draw worshipful, all-limbs-beautiful; this very should follow in argha-vessel also, mark.

[tal-a27-v29] In venerable Brahmayāmala was said: vessel, cow-mouth-supreme, elephant-tortoise-base, pot-round-śakti-born-form.

[tal-a27-v30] Bead-thread and should make there indeed worship sequence, hero-substance-water-born-pearl-gem-gold-born.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-paṅkticakrakaśūlābjavidhinā tūramāśrayet / tallakṣaṇaṃ bruve śrīmatpicuśāstre nirūpitam tūre yogaḥ sadā śastaḥ siddhido doṣavarjite / jālakairjarjarai randhrairdantairūnādhikai rujā yukte ca tūre hāniḥ syāt taddhīne yāga uttamaḥ / kāmya eva bhavettūramiti kecitprapedire guravastu vidhau kāmye yatnāddoṣāṃstyajediti / vyācakṣate picuproktaṃ na nitye karmaṇītyadaḥ śrīsiddhātantra uktaṃ ca tūralakṣaṇamuttamam / ekādikacatuṣkhaṇḍe gomukhe pūrṇacandrake padmagorocanāmuktānīrasphaṭikasaṃnibhe / ekādipañcasadrandhravidyārekhānvite śubhe na rūkṣavakraśakaladīrghanimnasabinduke / ślakṣṇayā vajrasūcyātra sphuṭaṃ devīgaṇānvitam sarvaṃ samālikhetpūjyaṃ sarvāvayavasundaram / etadevānusartavyamarghapātre@pi lakṣaṇam śrībrahmayāmale@pyuktaṃ pātraṃ gomukhamuttamam / gajakūrmatalaṃ kumbhavṛttaśaktikajākṛti akṣasūtramatho kuryāttatraivābhyarcayetkramam / vīradhātujalodbhūtamuktāratnasuvarṇajam

chunks.l2:
[tal-a27-v31] Bead-thread, sequence-extracted, rudrākṣa, or especially hundred, tithi-superior, or-even with-eight, or-even its-half.

[tal-a27-v32] Its-half, or-then fifty-joined, he should consider that; mouths five, from consciousness-pulse-knowledge-will-action-union.

[tal-a27-v33] Fivefold-end-going, unity-thus-penultimate-bead-going, rite, by śakti-and-its-division: there two-form is said.

[tal-a27-v34] Then in double-measure but two-formed nyāsa he should perform; then even in double, by creation-dissolution-pair, him.

[tal-a27-v35] Mātṛkā, Mālinī, or-then: he should place in ether-sixteen-measured; in supreme but two, having-placed-having-placed, before impelled-ones.

[tal-a27-v36] In initiation primarily mantras those fifteen, the daiśika; if or by tattva-bhuvana-kalā-mantra-pada-phoneme.

[tal-a27-v37] By number-differences in made in thread: him him nyāsa guru should perform; having-made bead-thread, of it also all should be as altar.

[tal-a27-v38] By worshipped and by that very japa should perform undistracted: rite said this in venerable Mālinīvijayottara.

[tal-a27-v39] Wheel-like-whirling-this-what-he-says: he japa would be; if he sees, he offers this in awakening-fire, from entering.

[tal-a27-v40] Or argha-great-vessel should make that supreme param; coconut-and, bilva, golden, silver, and or.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-akṣasūtraṃ kramotkṛṣṭaṃ raudrākṣaṃ vā viśeṣataḥ / śataṃ tithyuttaraṃ yadvā sāṣṭaṃ yadvā tadardhakam tadardhaṃ vātha pañcāśadyuktaṃ tatparikalpayet / vaktrāṇi pañca citspandajñānecchākṛtisaṃgateḥ pañcadhādyantagaṃ caikyamityupāntyākṣago vidhiḥ / śaktitadvatprabhedena tatra dvairūpyamucyate tato dviguṇamāne tu dvirūpaṃ nyāsamācaret / tato@pi dviguṇe sṛṣṭisaṃhṛtidvitayena tam mātṛkāṃ mālinīṃ vātha nyasyetkhaśarasaṃmite / uttame tu dvayīṃ nyasyennyasya pūrvaṃ pracoditān dīkṣāyāṃ mukhyato mantrāṃstānpañcadaśa daiśikaḥ / yadi vā tattvabhuvanakalāmantrapadārṇajaiḥ saṃkhyābhedaiḥ kṛte sūtre taṃ taṃ nyāsaṃ guruścaret / kṛtvākṣasūtraṃ tasyāpi sarvaṃ sthaṇḍilavadbhavet pūjitena ca tenaiva japaṃ kuryādatandritaḥ / vidhiruktastvayaṃ śrīmanmālinīvijayottare cakravadbhramayannetadyadvakti sa japo bhavet / yadīkṣate juhotyetadbodhāgnau saṃpraveśanāt athavārghamahāpātraṃ kuryāttaccottaraṃ param / nārikelamatho bailvaṃ sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ ca vā

chunks.l2:
[tal-a27-v41] Of it also this rite all in installation-beginning was declared; by its unshaking fluids full, having made in this worship sequence.

[tal-a27-v42] Downward-faced always to be placed; worshipped in worship again, that vessel upward-faced; and that empty should make not, such.

[tal-a27-v43] At worship-end, that-fluid-full-self having disposed, that downward-faced and having fully worshipped, he should place, the wise.

[tal-a27-v44] Sword, dagger, or-even scissors, mirror, and or, pure, so-thus should make as venerable Kālī-mouth spoken.

[tal-a27-v45] In venerable Bhairavakula was said in Kula-festival-pre-worship: on altar-in-fire, on cloth, on liṅga, on vessel, on lotus-then, on maṇḍala.

[tal-a27-v46] On image, on pot-in-heap, on brick, on thread-then: should worship by own, by own service; mixture should reject — thus.

[tal-a27-v47] As in waters for peace, mantras so in weapons and the rest certainly; enemy-cutting-and-the-rest-doers, desired from, mixture abandoned.

[tal-a27-v48] Of the desireless but they, from that-that-place-condition-power certainly: fetter-cutting-purified-tattva-nourishing-and-the-rest-doers.

[tal-a27-v49] Or-else book, such-seizing-śāstra-sequence-possessing, well-purified, by-initiated-made: there also this rite is remembered.

[tal-a27-v50] Thus in self-installations, as long as standing is: by abundance tarpaṇa, purity so long interruption-avoidance.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-tasyāpyeṣa vidhiḥ sarvaḥ pratiṣṭhādau prakīrtitaḥ / tanniṣkamparasaiḥ pūrṇaṃ kṛtvāsminpūjayetkramam adhomukhaṃ sadā sthāpyaṃ pūjitaṃ pūjane punaḥ / tatpātramunmukhaṃ tacca riktaṃ kuryānna tādṛśam pūjānte tadrasāpūrṇamātmānaṃ pravidhāya tat / adhomukhaṃ ca saṃpūjya sthāpayet vicakṣaṇaḥ khaṅgaṃ kṛpāṇikāṃ yadvā kartarīṃ makuraṃ ca vā / vimalaṃ tattathā kuryācchrīmatkālīmukhoditam śrībhairavakule@pyuktaṃ kulaparvaprapūjane / sthaṇḍile@gnau paṭe liṅge pātre padme@tha maṇḍale mūrtau ghaṭe@strasaṃghāte dhaṭe sūtre@tha pūjayet / svena svenopacāreṇa saṅkaraṃ varjayediti yathāpsu śāntaye mantrāstadvadastrādiṣu dhruvam / śatrucchedādikartāraḥ kāmyo@taḥ saṅkarojjhitaḥ akāmasya tu te tattatsthānopādhivaśāddhruvam / pāśakartanasaṃśuddhatattvāpyāyādikāriṇaḥ athavā pustakaṃ tādṛgrahaḥśāstrakramombhitam / suśuddhaṃ dīkṣitakṛtaṃ tatrāpyeṣa vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ itthaṃ svayaṃpratiṣṭheṣu yāvadyāvatsthitirbhavet / vibhavaistarpaṇaṃ śuddhistāvadvicchedavarjanam

chunks.l2:
[tal-a27-v51] Hence indeed when many-days maṇḍala-construction: then in-day in-day should perform by abundance tarpaṇa, much.

[tal-a27-v52] In installation and everywhere guru, aforesaid supreme, having sought true reality, presence he should make clear.

[tal-a27-v53] In accomplished but in tanmayatva-state in fruit, by putraka-sādhakas to another, from that pair to either, that is offered.

[tal-a27-v54] Of it also this rite all in its absence but in every way: in deep water it to be cast, having asked pardon, having dismissed, and.

[tal-a27-v55] Thus this self-installation-rite, Śiva-set-forth: in other-installed in liṅga, in Bāṇa-then, in svayambhū.

[tal-a27-v56] In all-asana-side, having placed before, should worship sequence: pure-impure-adhva-ones, all mantras, all Śiva-ending.

[tal-a27-v57] Adhva and here in seat was said that everywhere worship this; invocation-dismissal but there as before should perform.

[tal-a27-v58] Was said in tantra also Aghoreśa, in Svacchanda, by Lord; so or-else daily as said by half-half-portion-appointment.

[tal-a27-v59] Having made desired maṇḍala there, all sequence should worship, of much kind different, liṅga-worship was set forth.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-ata eva yadā bhūridinaṃ maṇḍalakalpanam / tadā dine dine kuryādvibhavaistarpaṇaṃ bahu pratiṣṭhāyāṃ ca sarvatra guruḥ pūrvoditaṃ param / satattvamanusandhāya saṃnidhiṃ sphuṭamācaret siddhe tu tanmayībhāve phale putrakasādhakaiḥ / anyasmai taddvayādanyatarasmai tatsamarpyate tasyāpyeṣa vidhiḥ sarvastadalābhe tu sarvathā / agādhe@mbhasi tatkṣepyaṃ kṣamayitvā visṛjya ca ityeṣa svapratiṣṭhānavidhiḥ śivanirūpitaḥ / parapratiṣṭhite liṅge bāṇīye@tha svayaṃbhuvi sarvamāsanapakṣe prāṅnyasya saṃpūjayetkramam / śuddhāśuddhādhvajāḥ sarve mantrāḥ sarvaḥ śivāntakaḥ adhvā cehāsane proktastatsarvatrārcayedidam / āvāhanavisṛṣṭī tu tatra prāgvatsamācaret uktaṃ tantre@pyaghoreśe svacchande vibhunā tathā / athavā pratyahaṃ proktamānārdhārdhaniyogataḥ kṛtveṣṭaṃ maṇḍalaṃ tatra samastaṃ kramamarcayet / bahuprakārabhinnasya liṅgasyārcā nirūpitā
